## Target context
- Repo: DontPanic-agent-command-surface

- Project: (none)
- Command: 0 (see structured target_context.commands_run)

[F005] I implemented F005 with no side-effecting commands beyond the targeted test runs (Repo: DontPanic-agent-command-surface, Env: dev, Project: (none)). I added a shared `command_help_agent_snippet(command)` helper to `command_guidance.py` that projects each command's F002 inventory entry (class label + predecessor hints + escalation rule) into a short, class-specific `--help` footer, then wired one representative command per class through it as an argparse `epilog`: `next` (read-only — "safe to run before mutation"), `doctor` (diagnostic), `setup` (config), `plan lock` (lifecycle — "mutate only when DontPanic asks"), `dispatch-from-plan` (dispatch/paid — "do not start paid/dispatch work unless DontPanic surfaced a ready candidate or the human explicitly approved it", appended to its existing quota epilog), and `dashboard` (human-handoff — points to the "local decision surface when available"); command behavior is unchanged since the snippet is help-text only. I added `test_f005_workflow_help_snippets.py` (15 tests covering all five acceptance criteria, proving the footers are embedded verbatim from the shared helper and composed from inventory fields rather than ad-hoc strings), all passing, and confirmed the F002/F003/F004 guidance suites (40 tests) plus the dashboard suites still pass — the lone renderer-parity failure is a pre-existing 1-second timestamp race that passes in isolation and is untouched by this change. I left `features.json` F005 `passes: false` for the auditor/
